opportunities.title: Main Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based organisations with a formal employment or contractual relationship to a host institution for the project duration; individuals without such a relationship, schools, further‑education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, and projects led by organisations not based in the UK are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: The Main Grants fund (Research, Development and Analysis Fund) offers up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) for research addressing one or more of the Foundation’s priority questions outlined in its Strategic Review.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organisations, particularly from racially minoritised communities, based in the UK; partnership applications are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: The Racial Diversity UK Fund supports research on racial diversity within the UK, with a focus on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and offers grants ranging from £15,000 to £500,000.
